code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low O₂ saturation, low pO₂), mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated monocytes and basophils, increased ferritin, CRP, and INR, and mildly elevated creatinine. These findings suggest acute severe respiratory failure with systemic inflammation, possible infection/sepsis, and early multi-organ involvement. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are recommended.
